item.description:
Your last message in a reply
- Replying shows your own last message as a bubble above the agent's, a scroll up from where the message opens - The shortcut recorder is steadier: keys stay shown until all are up, a chosen shortcut shows as saved, and Done goes back to Settings - The first open no longer freezes for a second while Perch checks whether a launcher has the keyboard

Smoother lists, and questions in full
- A question in the notch is shown in full, and hovering a choice shows its title, its note and whether it is recommended - Hovering a session in the list selects it, with a hand cursor, and the highlight follows the pointer smoothly without scrolling by itself - The arrow keys no longer jump back to where the mouse rests, in Settings and in the list - Command+comma closes Settings, the same shortcut that opens it - Settings: "Away from your Mac for" is now "Welcome back after"

Choose what the notch tells you
- Notify me about in Settings: switch off Finished, Needs your OK, Asked you something, Has a plan or Stopped on an error - Switching one off only quiets the notch: the list, the cards and the status rings still show everything - Each setting has a small icon, so the rows are easier to tell apart - A new release is offered at once, with no wait
